title: The Iron Uniform
author: Z. M. Blackwood
blurb: Ulyana Zhou, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
